task.originalRequest: Compare supplied synthetic policies, then propose an implementation. This stage only produces the comparison.
task.goal: Compare the two supplied policies against ownership and coordination criteria.
task.context: Synthetic fixture, not a benchmark. A: one lead owns planning and integration. B: a coordinator handles stable batches and asks an advisor about exceptions. Each unit independently evaluates one policy from this text; no unit consumes another unit's output.
acceptance: Address ownership and coordination for both policies; distinguish evidence from unmeasured claims.
constraints: Read-only. No web, tools, recursive delegation, or performance claims.
